test_title: PYST 12: SSC CHSL 2024 - Reasoning (Held On: 03 Jul, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question:
Identify the figure given in the options that when put in place of the question mark (?) will logically complete the series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5b7074e870c53687294cc4461768f3bec3757ec9da7eaffe4d755971e9bd47a6.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is :

1) The first box series → Corner elements shift in the clockwise direction and the rest elements interchange positions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/101cdb62390c2ca15fa683c8c13105f092e378c246db984486fa0e3f0f747e4a.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c7b62707b23f10324c7e99b50061413a92b3f5f18497c995060bc4a8f5c54d05.png] 

2) The second box series → Bottom elements shift in the clockwise direction and the rest elements interchange positions. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6ee3c43912995584760fea607d3a3f71c523df6bc178993d6828397b8819b9f1.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3a8ab3edd5cf3d2f8e89971402fc6f99203facc23bbaff886293c28f9d8f80a4.png] 

Thus, the final series is :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2824cd90627c2c438347b56184535ee2f962868be81bd3fd5cacd75e2b9dc307.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fa0b12c13f4215c920fbe216d6b98c6af78297fb5bc1894783ed81be9920b0f6.png] 

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
